origin.description: Pipe a value into a function or call for its side effect, and return the original value.

arguments.name: lhs
arguments.text: A value, or the dot placeholder.

arguments.name: rhs
arguments.text: A function or a call, using the same rules as %>%.

origin.details: The tee runs the right-hand side and then yields the left-hand side, not the right-hand side's return value. Later tee steps therefore still see that original value. The call is evaluated even when it ignores its argument, because the dot is read again after the call.

translation.description: Run the steps for their effect and return the original value.

arguments.name: lhs
arguments.text: The value to return. DOT builds a functional sequence that returns its input.

arguments.name: steps
arguments.text: The same callable and (function, args, kwargs) steps as pipe.

translation.details: Each step is invoked, and its return value is discarded. The value passed onward is the input of the tee, so every step in a tee-only chain sees that same value. Earlier steps still run when a later step ignores its argument.
translation.example:
from magrittr.pipe import tee
tee(list(range(1, 11)), sum)
